explain: food 不可数名词用 is

explain: if 引导的真实条件句，主将从现

explain: 一般过去时，单数主语用 was。

explain: 一般过去时的不规则动词 die → died。

q: ____ then on, the farmer stopped working.
explain: 固定短语 from then on "从那时起"。

q: All his vegetables ____ because he stopped working.

explain: 一般现在时第三人称单数：it + lives。

q: A lion is also ____ the "King of the Animals".

explain: may all disappear = 可能都消失。

explain: 主语 roads and schools 复数 + have。

explain: 已故人物用过去时 was。

explain: 祈使句否定：Don't + 动词原形。

q: You ____ wait for your turn patiently.

q: I ____ busy yesterday, so I didn't reply.
explain: 一般过去时 I 用 was。

q: I will ____ to South Africa to see the nature.

explain: if + 条件，主将从现：主句用 will。
